components.name: ProjectFolder
components.doc: A folder whose flap leans open on hover and whose sheets rise and fan out on click.

components.name: ProjectFolderPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: three project folders; opening one closes the others.

members.name: name
members.doc: File name, printed at the top of its sheet.

members.name: kind
members.doc: What the little sheet shows: lines of text, a bar chart, or a picture.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Short line under the name while the folder is closed, such as "12 files, edited 2h ago".

members.name: files
members.doc: Files in the folder. The first three peek out; the rest are counted.

members.name: tone
members.doc: `accent` fills the folder with the accent color; `neutral` keeps it quiet.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the folder is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the folder starts open when uncontrolled.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when a click or key press opens or closes the folder.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the folder button.
